issues.description: The type of the Person.id field is inconsistent between artifacts: the problem statement and server-side code expect UUID identifiers (endpoints use UUID path variables), the template common model defines id as UUID, but the solution common model defines id as Long. This mismatch will cause compilation/runtime errors and prevents students from mapping the model to the server endpoints.
issues.suggestedFix: Unify the Person.id type across all artifacts. The simplest fix is to change the solution's common Person.id field and its getter/setter to use java.util.UUID (matching the template and server-side usage). Alternatively, update server-side endpoints and services to use Long consistently—but the recommended fix is to use UUID everywhere to match the problem specification and template.
